download_seeker_lm_xl_model: download the SeeKeR LM XL GPT2-XL model to the specified datapath
run_download_function: run the download function to fetch the SeeKeR LM XL model for ParlAI
review_download_function: review the download function that downloads the SeeKeR LM XL model using seeker_download
summarize_seeker_lm_xl_module: summarize the SeeKeR LM XL module that provides a GPT2-XL model fine-tuned on SeeKeR data
test_download_seeker_model: test the download function by calling it with a datapath to fetch the SeeKeR LM XL model
